text:
zoe: deploy-bot blocked push for `redwood/worker:2026-04-12` in us-west-2 — attestation verify failed: cosign KMS alias not resolvable in target region. anyone oncall for signing infra?

deploy-bot: Automated: publish blocked tag `2026-04-12` (build 7901). reason: attestation_kms_alias_missing. suggested: retag to known digest or re-sign in-region.

leo: quick check: signer used alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222:alias/redwood-sign. us-west-2 verifier tries DescribeKey against us-west-2 alias and errors.

publishbot: we can retag to previous digest and attach existing attestation. that'll be fastest inside change window (15:00-16:00 UTC).

zoe: okay proceed with retag. I'll open release-note PR and note KMS rotation as root cause.

publishbot: retagging now -> creating tag `2026-04-12-retag-1844445555`, injecting attestation, promoting to `2026-04-12`. needs manual approve.

opsbot: retention check: pinned digest will bypass auto GC for 7 days.

zoe: approved. leo please run retag command and paste output.

leo: running: ./tools/ecr-retag --repo redwood/worker --from-digest sha256:cc33dd44 --to-tag 2026-04-12 --region us-west-2

publishbot: retag complete. attestation attached and verified. tag now points to sha256:cc33dd44 in us-west-2.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled in 10m to pinned digest. monitor error rate and rollout CPU.

zoe: PR #1022 opened: "Pin 2026-04-12 to prior digest in us-west-2; note KMS alias replication". assigning @leo. added rollback steps.

leo: filing INF-4522 to add verifier fallback: if alias lookup fails in region, try DescribeKey with key ARN region from attestation. also add CI test to validate cross-region verify during pre-publish.

zoe: good. runbook update: avoid KMS alias rotation during publish windows. I'll coordinate with security.

publishbot: closing retag job. monitoring canary for 20m.

zoe: closing thread — monitor for spikes and escalate if needed.
